# FilePicker

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:file-picker` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A compact browse trigger and a dashed drop zone around native file inputs, with wiring that reports chosen and dropped files.

## When to use

Let people choose or drop files (attachments, evidence, imports) without app CSS: a link-toned browse trigger (or, with tone, emphasis, or size, one that looks like the Button beside it) and a dashed drop target that highlights while dragging, both around visually hidden native file inputs.

- People attach or import files by browsing or by dropping them onto a target.

**Not when:**

- Do not style a native file input or label from app CSS; use these components.
- Do not rely on the drop zone alone; it also opens the chooser when clicked or activated from the keyboard.

**Alternatives:**

- [Button](./wa-button.md) (prefer-over) — A button cannot open the native chooser without script; the trigger is a label around the input.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/file-picker` — exports `FilePickerTrigger`, `FileDropZone`, `wireFilePickers`, `fileMatchesAccept`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/file-picker` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/file-picker.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Wiring: `wireFilePickers` from `@kerfjs/ui/wire-file-pickers` (required).
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/file-picker`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuifile-picker) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- browse trigger
- browse trigger with the Button look: tone, emphasis, and size as on Button, for a toolbar or form row beside Buttons
- drop zone
- dragging
- disabled
- accept filter
- multiple or single
- dropScope: a selector for an enclosing panel that also takes drops, highlighting the zone while files are over any part of it

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** what happens to the reported files (upload, validation, limits); the list of chosen files; copy and accepted types.

**Wiring:** `wireFilePickers` is required.

- Reports chosen and dropped files and accepts drops on the zone; without it drops open the file in the browser.

**Wiring-owned state attributes** — never render, remove, or branch on these as app state:

- `data-dragging` on `kui-file-picker (drop zone)` (`wireFilePickers`): "true" while files are dragged over the zone.

## Geometry

Margin: self · border: self · padding: self (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- The drop zone carries the 8px content-item inline margin; the trigger is a compact 32px inline control, or with the Button look the same size as a Button of that size.

## Accessibility

- Each control is a label around a real file input that receives keyboard focus; the visible control shows the focus ring. Give the input an accessibleLabel when the visible copy is short.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-file-picker`, `kui-file-picker__title`, `kui-file-picker__detail`, `kui-file-picker__input`, `kui-file-picker__icon`.

Never put `kui-file-picker`, `kui-file-picker__title`, `kui-file-picker__detail`, `kui-file-picker__input`, `kui-file-picker__icon` on an element you write; render `FilePickerTrigger` or `FileDropZone` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-text-link`, `--kui-color-brand-fill-quiet`, `--kui-color-neutral-border-loud`, `--kui-color-neutral-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-text`, `--kui-focus-ring`, `--kui-font-xs`, `--kui-font-2xs`, `--kui-font-weight-semibold`, `--kui-layout-inline-margin`, `--kui-layout-rounded-radius`, `--kui-radius-pill`, `--kui-space-2xs`, `--kui-space-s`, `--kui-space-xs`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
